issue_context.title: System.Text.Json - JsonSerializer issue when deserializing property of type System.Version
comments:
We can add a new internal converter for this. Given prior art from Newtonsoft.Json and just `.ToString()`, we'd want to serialize `Version` instances as "1.2.3.4" instead of `{ "Major": 1, "Minor": 2, ... }`.

The workaround for 3.1 & 5 is to [write a custom converter](https://docs.microsoft.com/dotnet/standard/serialization/system-text-json-converters-how-to) for the `Version` type.

review_comments:
I think throwing like this is fine (where we have raw JsonException without special text for Version and without inner exception from Parse). So as-is we'll get a fairly nice message like this:
```
System.Text.Json.JsonException : The JSON value could not be converted to System.Version. Path: $ | LineNumber: 0 | BytePositionInLine: 2.
```

Yup we have the same pattern for [Uri](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/98cba4cec14274fd2abaa88534814eac1e7eb573/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/Converters/Value/UriConverter.cs#L16) and [KeyValuePair](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/98cba4cec14274fd2abaa88534814eac1e7eb573/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/Converters/Object/KeyValuePairConverter.cs#L81).
